card.name: Sentence-ending periods before "The"
card.fires_on: The period or colon that ends a sentence or citation title, right where the next sentence is likely to start with "The". It also fires on a few similar spots, such as the end of a heading or a digit inside a dose list.

modes.label: Citation title end
modes.description: Closing period and quote after a name in an encyclopedia MLA citation, followed by "The Catholic Encyclopedia".

modes.label: Sentence end in label text
modes.description: Period ending a sentence in drug-label text, with the next sentence likely to begin with "The".
modes.example: Isolated cases of overdose with oxcarbazepine tablets have been reported<<.>> The maximum dose taken was approximately 4

modes.label: Heading end before The
modes.description: Age-group or credit heading that is followed by a sentence starting with "The".
modes.example: 2.3 Children 12 Months to 5 Years of<< Age>> The recommended dose of desloratad

card.writes: It lowers the chance that the next word is "the" and nudges toward other words, some non-English.
card.plain: It marks the end of a sentence where "The" would usually come next, and pushes the model away from predicting it.
